# Image Resizer

Image Resizer is a browser-based tool for resizing images and creating smaller public sharing copies.

Canonical URL: https://resize.imageprivacy.org/

## Features

- Resize images by width and height
- Keep aspect ratio
- Export JPEG, PNG, or WebP
- Process images locally in the browser

## Privacy model

The selected image is processed in the browser using canvas. Exporting creates a resized copy and removes most embedded metadata.
